name: commons-app-builder
description: Build Room Commons apps (an HTML page on room databases) from a one-line request: data model first, the window.artifact bridge, a phone-width-first UX bar, and verification before replying. GUIDE.md is the portable method; SKILL.md is the Sutando wrapper. Config: BUILD_THREAD_CONVERSATION (default false) lets a build also speak in the app's own thread (BUILD_REQUEST.md, "In the app's thread").
